name: shanshui-mingtang-fengshui-gis
description: Shanshui Mingtang Feng Shui GIS is an AI-assisted WebGIS platform for traditional landscape pattern interpretation.  Users can draw a study area on the map, summarize elevation, slope, aspect, terrain relief, roughness, and river-water relations, then generate a cultural Feng Shui interpretation based on structured GIS analysis results.
